Messages.Body:
I am new to jyhad and have a question concerning the master phase.
a friend of mine typically has 3 short-term investments on the board
at a time and as part of his master phase he removes one counter from
each to add 3 blood to his pool. My interperetation of the rules is
that he could only move from one short term investment as his master
phase action, since moving three would require 3 master phase actions.

Any help would be appreciated.

Also I am used to magic where there is a 4 card (of one type) limit,
are there any such standard card limiting conventions for Jyhad?

Thanks again,
Nathan Carbino
ncar...@ptc.com

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ncar...@ptc.com wrote:
>
> I am new to jyhad and have a question concerning the master phase.
> a friend of mine typically has 3 short-term investments on the board
> at a time and as part of his master phase he removes one counter from
> each to add 3 blood to his pool. My interperetation of the rules is
> that he could only move from one short term investment as his master
> phase action, since moving three would require 3 master phase actions.

You are correct. Unless you have more than one Master Phase Action
(using Anson, Rumors of Gehenna, and/or the Parthenon), you can only
move a blood off of *one* of your investments (instead of playing
*one* master card).

> Also I am used to magic where there is a 4 card (of one type) limit,
> are there any such standard card limiting conventions for Jyhad?

No.
VtES / Jyhad was designed for unlimited card resources.

Messages.Author: James E. Hamblin
Messages.Body:
ncar...@ptc.com wrote:
>
> I am new to jyhad and have a question concerning the master phase.
> a friend of mine typically has 3 short-term investments on the board
> at a time and as part of his master phase he removes one counter from
> each to add 3 blood to his pool. My interperetation of the rules is
> that he could only move from one short term investment as his master
> phase action, since moving three would require 3 master phase actions.

The way to think about this is exactly what you said: during each master
phase, you get one (and only one) master phase action. You can use this
action to play a master card, or to do an effect (like take 1 blood off
of _one_ Short Term).

> Also I am used to magic where there is a 4 card (of one type) limit,
> are there any such standard card limiting conventions for Jyhad?

No. There is no official card limit, though many groups play with CL as
a house rule. At some point, groups decide that they need some sort of
house rule to stop degenerate decks. There are two main options:

* Card Limits, ranging from 3CL to 6CL

* Golden Tenets:
- No Repeat Actions
- No Vote Pushing (i.e., only 1 Political Action card played per
Political Action by each player).

I personally prefer the latter, and it is a modification of the latter
which is the official DCI tournament rule.

James
